source.note: Peña's own taxonomy, verbatim: 'Seven Steps for Super Success' — slide 1025 (also slides 444 and 723).

statuses.waiting: Built, waiting on one thing you own
statuses.partial: Half live — some pieces proven, some not
statuses.yours: Yours — the bot cannot do this one for you

order.title: Perfect the seven
order.detail: Each step below does its one thing reliably on real deals. Nothing else starts until these are boring.

order.title: Perfect the machinery
order.detail: Then tighten what sits underneath: retries, ledgers, duplicate prevention, audit, cost guards.

order.title: Make it recursive
order.detail: Then let outcomes feed the scoring, the letters and the vertical playbooks so cycle 30 beats cycle 1.

workstreams.name: Creating your personal foundation
workstreams.pena_says: Creating your personal foundation — *New rules *Beyond Common Sense *Focus on ends, not means *Passion *Get comfortable
workstreams.one_line: New rules, beyond common sense, focus on ends not means, passion, get comfortable.
workstreams.bot_does: Nothing. This one is not delegable, and a bot that pretended to do it would be selling you a feeling.
workstreams.you_get: The only step with no automation — and no shame about it.
workstreams.next: The bot's job is to keep the other six from eating the time this one needs.

workstreams.name: Clarify your vision
workstreams.one_line: Decide exactly what you are buying: vertical, size, geography, and the number that makes it worth doing.
workstreams.bot_does: Turns that decision into hard filters and refuses anything outside them — vertical floors, revenue bands, reject codes.
workstreams.you_get: A written buy-box the machine can't drift from. Every listing judged against it, not against mood.
workstreams.next: Put the buy-box numbers in one file so the ICP lives in one place instead of in a prompt.

workstreams.name: Building the perception
workstreams.one_line: Everything a stranger sees — the letters, the one-pager, the way the ask is phrased.
workstreams.bot_does: Renders role-specific letters that read like a buyer with money, not a searcher with hope: no invented numbers, one clear question.
workstreams.you_get: Letters already written and addressed — broker, CPA, counsel, lender — each carrying the right ask for that role.
workstreams.next: A one-page buyer profile attached to every letter, so the ask has something behind it.

workstreams.name: Creating your Dream Team
workstreams.cite: slide 1025 · on the method: slide 2158 — "You must kiss a lot of frogs! Period!"
workstreams.one_line: Chairman, board, CPA, counsel, banker — plus the moles who tell you what a market is really doing.
workstreams.bot_does: Finds the firms, verifies the addresses, writes to one person per firm, and keeps the frog-kissing cadence without you dialling.
workstreams.you_get: 31 verified people across four roles, every address MX-checked. The chairman conversation is still yours — Peña kissed those frogs himself.
workstreams.blocker: Your email address + app password (GMAIL_ADDRESS, GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD)
workstreams.next: Send the first wave the day mail is on; the court tracker then shows which of the four seats are filled.

workstreams.name: Your Quantum Leap War Action Plan
workstreams.pena_says: V Your Quantum Leap War Action Plan — *Growth *Working capital *Financing-internal growth *Acquisition-external growth
workstreams.cite: slide 1025 · on tempo: slide 1899 — "You must spend 95% of your time in the pursuit of money (and deals)."
workstreams.one_line: The whole acquisition engine: find, filter, score, approach, read replies, structure, finance, close.
workstreams.bot_does: Runs the daily cycle end to end — sources listings, builds the 7-field deal file, scores against 10 factors, stages outreach on both channels, reads replies, drafts the LOI, tests 1.5x coverage.
workstreams.you_get: 43 listings → 11 complete deal files → GO/NO-GO scores → letters staged → an LOI that refuses to render if a money figure was guessed.
workstreams.blocker: Email channel needs the same password as step IV; forms and paperwork run without it
workstreams.next: Build the red-flag sweep and target-profile card so the score sits on evidence instead of a listing headline.

workstreams.name: Pay yourself, directors, employees first
workstreams.pena_says: VI Pay yourself, directors, employees first
workstreams.cite: slide 1025 · expanded at slide 2034: "Step 3: Pay yourself and your staff FIRST. Through good times AND bad times."
workstreams.one_line: The money leaves in the right order on day one, not month six.
workstreams.bot_does: Builds the closing funds flow and the 90-day transition plan so payroll, the seller note and your own draw are sequenced before anything discretionary.
workstreams.you_get: A closing checklist naming who gets paid, when, and out of which account.
workstreams.blocker: Closing and transition tasks are specified, not built
workstreams.next: Build the funds-flow builder — it's the one artifact that makes this step real.

workstreams.name: Creating your exit strategy
workstreams.cite: slide 1025 · seven-step expansion at slide 2034 (independent of you → turnkey → pay first → puff up the hog → houseclean → sell / go public / franchise → repeat)
workstreams.one_line: Build it to sell it: independent of you, turnkey, cleaned up — then repeat.
workstreams.bot_does: Logs why each deal lived or died and feeds that back into scoring and letters. Nothing beyond the record yet.
workstreams.you_get: Nothing yet — this is the loop that makes the system improve instead of repeat.
workstreams.blocker: Needs outcome data, which needs step V running for a few weeks
workstreams.next: Log outcomes from day one so the data exists when this gets built.

workstreams.name: The engine room — not one of Peña's seven
workstreams.pena_says: Not in the source. This is the machine that runs the seven, and it is labelled as ours.
workstreams.one_line: It wakes up daily, refuses to spend money, refuses to send twice, and keeps a log of everything it did.
workstreams.bot_does: Schedules the cycle, gates credentials, stamps provenance, and (once built) holds single-flight locks, an audit log, dead-letter retry and a kill switch.
workstreams.you_get: Today: a daily cycle that runs and reports. Missing: the locks and audit trail that make it safe to leave alone for a month.
workstreams.next: Single-flight lock, audit log, dead-letter retry, kill switch — every other step's honesty depends on these.
